readings.moment: At dinner, when the temple struck nine, Félix took out his watch and it showed twenty minutes to nine.
At dinner, the temple struck nine.
When the temple struck ten, Félix's watch showed twenty minutes to ten.
Ten slow deep notes sounded from Uncle's repeater after the thump in the atelier.
Someone went quickly up the stairs past the library door.
A thump was heard on the floor of the atelier, right above the library.
Someone came quickly down the stairs.
Bastien Girard came into the library.
The temple struck eleven, when Félix and Girard were still sitting together in the library.

durations: Six minutes between someone going up the stairs (10:15 by Félix's watch) and someone coming down (10:21 by Félix's watch) (implied).
Three minutes between the thump in the atelier (10:18 by Félix's watch) and someone coming quickly down the stairs (10:21 by Félix's watch) (implied).

About twenty-eight minutes during which Girard and Félix sat together in the library, from Girard's arrival at 10:32 by Félix's watch until the temple struck eleven (implied; the two ends are read on different timepieces).
whereabouts: Félix was at dinner, where everyone brought their watches to the table.
Félix's uncle was at the dinner table and made a scene about Félix's watch in front of everyone.
Bastien Girard was at dinner and laughed at the uncle's remark about Félix's watch.
Félix and Girard quarrelled over the price at dinner, though Félix's 'they' does not name the other party.
After dinner Félix went up to the library and stayed there alone.
In the library, Félix poured himself a brandy and then another.
Félix was on the floor directly below the atelier, where the library was located.
Félix's uncle sat upstairs in the atelier with his repeater.
Someone went quickly up the stairs past the library door at 10:15 by Félix's watch; Félix did not see who it was.
Someone came quickly down the stairs at 10:21 by Félix's watch; Félix did not see who it was.
Félix's aunt's piano was playing downstairs before the thump.
Félix's aunt was standing very straight by the stairs.
Rosa was seen in the hall (Félix recalls her face there).
Bastien Girard came into the library at 10:32 by Félix's watch, saying he had come to talk about the repeater and the price.
Félix and Girard sat together in the library until the temple struck eleven.
Félix poured Girard a brandy in the library, and Girard did not drink it.
